server_cwd_policy: Explicit current repository root; old Popen inherited caller CWD, historical actual CWD unrecorded
server_argv_policy: Byte-for-byte argv from sealed M8-I1 execution_commands.server
single_variable: Passive identity observation and bounded matching-identity confirmation; no map argument, resource or intended CWD change
on_map_mismatch: Persist identity and XODR then immediately reject; no reload or second process
authorization: Separate user approval required after offline acceptance; no runtime authorization in this protocol
